subject: Commit gatehouse: Brookline Energy pricing approvals & SFDC hygiene
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commit gatehouse: Brookline Energy pricing approvals & SFDC hygiene

Team — quick hygiene / commit ask ahead of Friday's forecast close. Two asks: 1) status + approvals for Brookline Energy (DL-2027-1843) and 2) SFDC stage accuracy for any deals with unapproved discounts.

High-level:
- Brookline Energy (Primary contact: Julian Ford) — marketing cloud + inference bundle. Current opp shows a manual 25% discount in SFDC, but Deal Desk approved 20% provisional. Finance needs to sign off on the final terms before we mark as committed.
- Please update SFDC stage to the correct state: if pricing is still under Deal Desk / Finance review, set stage to "Commit - pricing pending" and add expected approval date in the "Commit Date" field.

Specific asks (today):
- Marcus: share the Deal Desk approval thread and confirm which SKU/term line items are impacted. If you think finance needs an explicit revenue condition (usage cap, minimum term), call it out.
- Laura: be ready to expedite finance review if Deal Desk approves a final package. We ideally need a sign-off by EOD Tue 2027-06-29 to include in the July forecast.
- Vanessa: hold any sales-level commit pushes until finance confirms — we want clean commit hygiene for forecasting.

Attached: Deal_Pricing_Summary.xlsx with the current price vs SFDC lines.

Thanks — short and direct replies please.

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Manager, Americas
Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Deal_Pricing_Summary.xlsx (xlsx, 84KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit gatehouse: Brookline Energy pricing approvals & SFDC hygiene

Stephanie — thanks for flagging. Short status below, quoting your bullets inline for clarity.

> Brookline Energy — manual 25% in SFDC, Deal Desk approved 20% provisional; finance sign-off required.
- Current: Deal Desk (me) approved a 20% list discount on the base inference bundle and 15% on add-on services, contingent on a 36-month term and the attached usage SLA. We documented the approval in DocuSign for countersignature: https://www.docusign.com/recipient-status/ABCDEF123456
- Gap: SFDC currently shows 25% on the top-level opportunity. I flagged the discrepancy and recommended setting the opp discount to 20% and adding a note: "Deal Desk approval 2027-06-24; finance approval pending."

> Update SFDC stage to reflect pricing pending
- Will set to "Commit - pricing pending" now. I will also add an internal comment with the Deal Desk approval memo.

Attachments: brookline_pricing_notes.docx — includes the line-by-line SKU adjustments and suggested contract language (usage cap + overage rates).

Open items:
1) Finance needs an explicit revenue recognition/cap structure to approve the incremental discount (we propose a quarterly usage cap and an overage rate).
2) Contract needs countersignature (DocuSign sent to Julian).

If finance can expedite the signoff by Tue 6/29 we can lock the opp as committed in SFDC and include in July forecast. If not, we should keep the stage as "pricing pending" and exclude from committed figures.

--
Marcus Lin
Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
[Attachment: brookline_pricing_notes.docx (docx, 26KB)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit gatehouse: Brookline Energy pricing approvals & SFDC hygiene

Marcus / team — received. Quick finance take: we can approve a one-time additional concession up to 3% (net of list) to get this over the line provided the contract includes a quarterly usage cap and defined overage rates that limit downside to revenue.

Requested items for approval flow: 
- Please add the proposed usage cap and overage table into the contract (Marcus — your notes looked good; convert to a short table).
- Add a revenue note in SFDC: "Finance review: cap+overage included — approved up to 3% concession."
- Once Julian signs the DocuSign envelope, notify finance with the DocuSign confirmation link and the final SFDC snapshot (opp page).

I will prioritize review once I have the DocuSign signed copy. Expect a 24–48 hour turnaround from finance when the final contract language is present.

--
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations & Finance
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit gatehouse: Brookline Energy pricing approvals & SFDC hygiene

Copy — flagged for the sales leaders. Two operational asks:
1) Please avoid any manual overrides in SFDC that mark this as "Closed Won" until finance has provided final approval and we have DocuSign confirmation. We cannot risk a false commit in the forecast.
2) Marcus — once DocuSign completes, set the SFDC "Commit Date" and notify the forecasting channel. Stephanie — if you need me to ping Julian to speed signature, I can do that this week.

Short replies only pls — trying to keep the forecast clean for finance leadership.

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
